classification_reason: PASS. The exact-main publishing enhancement closes the observed host-transport gap: after verified cache miss and absent direct repo-file bridge, successful main validation exposes a connector-backed Zi Wei artifact that can be downloaded, byte-materialized, verified against GitHub digest plus exact commit/manifest identities, passed through the existing canonical bundle verifier/materializer, and executed in an isolated Python runtime.
